highlights.title: Transactions as a list
highlights.detail: Transactions, Subscriptions and the rule match list show as a list instead of a table. On a phone, each row has the name and the amount on the first line, and the details on the second line. On a wider screen, each row is one line. You do not scroll sideways, and the page scrolls as one.

highlights.title: Days you can fold
highlights.detail: When you sort transactions by date, they are grouped by day. Each day shows its total. Tap a day to fold or unfold its transactions.

highlights.title: Less clutter
highlights.detail: Dates are short, such as 19. okt. The account you use most is hidden, and a card account shows as a card icon. Amounts are bold.

highlights.title: Sort and load more
highlights.detail: Pick a sort field and the order in the control above each list. Each list shows 50 rows. Tap Show more at the bottom to see the next rows.
